# 4-Day Lisbon Trip Plan for Two Adults

A moderate-paced Lisbon trip with history, seafood, viewpoints, and one beach afternoon. I’ve kept the plan to no more than 2 major activities per day and fit the total budget to **€1,600 excluding international flights**.

## Lisbon Itinerary, Budget, and Rainy-Day Backup

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg

| Day | Plan | Estimated local cost for 2 | Rainy-day backup |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Apr 10 | Baixa/Chiado stroll + Alfama history walk | €22 | National Tile Museum + Time Out Market |
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/83/Lobster%2C_Time_Out_Market_Lisboa_%2850661858143%29.jpg Alt=| Apr 10 | Baixa/Chiado stroll + Alfama history walk | €22 | National Tile Museum + Time Out Market |, Lisbon, Portugal
| Apr 11 | Belém landmarks + riverside seafood lunch | €38 | Coach Museum + Pastéis de Belém café stop |
| Apr 12 | Scenic viewpoints + relaxed beach afternoon in Cascais | €46 | Oceanário de Lisboa + Parque das Nações walk |
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3c/Beach_near_Lisbon_Portugal%2C_1994..jpg Alt=| Apr 12 | Scenic viewpoints + relaxed beach afternoon in Cascais | €46 | Oceanário de Lisboa + Parque das Nações walk |, Lisbon, Portugal
| Apr 13 | Mouraria/Príncipe Real easy morning + departure buffer | €18 | Lisbon Story Centre + indoor café time |

### Day 1 — Old Town First Impressions
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive, check in, and do a gentle walk through **Baixa and Chiado**.
- **Afternoon:** Explore **Alfama** with a focus on historic lanes, viewpoints, and the cathedral area.
- **Dinner:** Seafood at a classic neighborhood spot; choose grilled fish or arroz de marisco.
- **Transport:** Airport to center by metro/taxi/ride-hail, then mostly on foot.
- **Estimated local transport:** **€22** for both.

### Day 2 — Belém and the River
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Visit **Belém Tower** and the **Monument to the Discoveries**.
- **Afternoon:** Add **Jerónimos Monastery** if energy is good, then a riverside walk.
- **Dinner:** Stay in Belém or return to the center for seafood near the river.
- **Transport:** Tram/taxi/ride-hail to Belém and back.
- **Estimated local transport:** **€38** for both.

### Day 3 — Viewpoints + Beach Reset
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/sun.svg
- **Morning:** Start at a scenic lookout such as **Miradouro da Senhora do Monte** or **Santa Catarina**.
- **Afternoon:** Take the train to **Cascais** for a relaxed beach afternoon and promenade time.
- **Dinner:** Casual seafood in Cascais or back in Lisbon if you prefer a quieter evening.
- **Transport:** City transit plus round-trip train to Cascais.
- **Estimated local transport:** **€46** for both.

### Day 4 — Easy Farewell Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg
- **Morning:** Slow breakfast and a final walk through **Mouraria** or **Príncipe Real**.
- **Afternoon:** Keep this light for shopping, coffee, or a museum before departure.
- **Dinner:** If your flight is later, choose one last seafood meal near your hotel or transit line.
- **Transport:** Short metro/taxi rides only.
- **Estimated local transport:** **€18** for both.

## Budget Fit for Two Adults

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-euro.svg

- **Local transport total:** about **€124**
- **Mid-range hotels for 4 nights:** about **€720–€920**
- **Meals and drinks:** about **€420–€560**
- **Sightseeing/entry fees:** about **€120–€180**
- **Buffer for taxis, snacks, and extras:** about **€100–€180**

**Projected total:** **€1,484–€1,964**

To stay safely within **€1,600**, aim for:
- hotel average around **€170–€210/night**
- 1–2 paid attractions only
- seafood lunches instead of expensive dinner-only splurges
- transit passes or a mix of metro, tram, and walking
